# test Level 4

This level tests parallel processing and streams: parallel groups, channels, streams, region memory (version 0.3, plan/decision_level4.md). Tests are deterministic: the same input gives the same output and the same errors in the same order.

A test is a project folder (D-073): `test/level4/d01_feature/` holds the driver `d01_feature.eve` and its `expect.json`. Test names start with `d`. No test is written yet: the features of this level are drafts.
